1: Before you clock in, let's pray. Father, thank You for the work in front of us today.
2: We want to do it right, the kind of work we don't have to hide from You.
3: Teach us Your Word the same way, careful and straight, so we handle it right.
4: And when we get tired or careless, steady our hands. In Jesus' name, amen.
5: Study to shew thyself approved unto God,
6: a workman that needeth not to be ashamed,
7: rightly dividing the word of truth.
9: Paul made tents for a living. He knew what a crooked cut cost you by quitting time.
10: Rightly dividing means a straight cut. Take the verse as it's written, not as you'd like it.
11: I've had a foreman walk my job and find it wrong. That shame teaches you fast.
12: God approves careful work, on the job and in the Book. Take your time and get it right.
13: Today, read one verse slow, twice, before you read anything else on that phone.
14: Somebody came to mind while you watched this. Send it to them before you start work.
15: Do good work today. Have a blessed day.
